public_api.resolve_product_type: str → Optional[str]. Returns canonical product type or None.
public_api.compute_alignment: (publication_id, marketplace, title, observed_categories, observed_surfaces, expected_category_coverage, ...) → Dict
public_api.run_alignment_on_db: (db_path=None) → Dict with total_publications, by_marketplace, totals, results

alignment_states.ALIGNED: Observed in at least one category that matches the expected commercial corridor.
alignment_states.MISALIGNED: Expected category known + coverage confirmed + product absent from expected + present elsewhere.
alignment_states.MULTI_CATEGORY: DEPRECATED as primary status — captured as is_multi_category=True when ALIGNED in multiple categories.

principles_enforced: Brand Hub is NOT a commercial category
Legacy configured category is NOT automatically expected category
Absence without coverage does NOT prove MISALIGNED
